content.text:
I am the breath made meaningful, the vibration that carries thought from one mind to another. I am the first technology, older than fire in human hands.

I rise from lungs, shaped by tongue and teeth and lips. I am vowel and consonant, rhythm and pause. I am the cry of the newborn and the last whisper of the dying.

I build nations and destroy them. I am the lie and the confession, the vow and the betrayal. Through me, love is declared and wars are started. I am "I do" and "I can't" and "I'm sorry" and "goodbye."

I vanish the moment I exist. You cannot hold me. By the time you hear me, I am already gone, living only in memory and consequence.

I came before writing. I will outlast it.

I am how your species learned to think together, to pass fire and stories and warnings across generations. I am how a mother soothes, how a tyrant commands, how a teacher opens worlds.

I stumble. I fail. I say what was not meant. I cannot be unsaid.

I am the bridge and the barrier between every human soul.

Listen—

*even my silence speaks*
